entries.title: AI news digest — 3 November 2026
entries.summary: Six stories added to the digest: Anthropic's amended S-1, Western Australia's facial-recognition trial, 42AI, Trajectory, the BBC neoclouds report and Indigenous art licensing.

entries.title: Agent Gitu v0.4.14
entries.summary: Mobile navigation and company-mode fixes, git commands in Cowork, and the new Pi runtime.
items: Home and Cowork now keep a clean horizontal switcher on narrow screens.
Company workspaces can be switched off, hiding the company icon and features.
Git push and version control commands run directly in Cowork.
Coding loop resiliency, verification rigor and safe git operations improved.
New Pi runtime with OAuth subscription sign-in and sign-out.

entries.title: Changelog published
entries.summary: This page is new. Product releases and site updates are recorded here, newest first, and refreshed whenever the news digest is checked.

entries.title: Agent Gitu v0.3.1
entries.summary: Quality release on top of the v0.3.0 architecture work.
items: 24 bug fixes across the model layer, server, memory and tools.
Memory learning loop wired through the session.
DeepSeek thinking-mode tool calls, vision gating and native streaming fixed.
Thinking indicator restored on resumed runs; desktop and connections UI refined.

entries.title: Agent Gitu v0.2.1
entries.summary: Reliability hardening: work that survives interruptions, automatic retries and a UI overhaul.
items: Specialists checkpoint every productive turn and can resume where they paused.
Network and provider failures retry automatically with backoff; real errors still fail fast.
Vision-checked completion gate for interface work, plus hybrid semantic retrieval.
Three-phase UI/UX overhaul and 50+ bug fixes.

entries.title: Agent Gitu v0.2.0
entries.summary: Language Server Protocol intelligence during coding, not just exposed tools.
items: Five LSP tools: diagnostics, definition, references, hover and symbols.
Servers start lazily per language, restart once on crash, then fall back cleanly.
Post-edit diagnostics reach the model before the evidence gate.
Task type now selects an investigation strategy at intake.

entries.title: Agent Gitu v0.1.9
items: Clearer delegation contract for specialist sub-agents.
Defensive lookups and a refreshed Windows installer.

entries.title: Agent Gitu v0.1.8
entries.summary: Acceptance criteria and evidence gates for delegated work.
items: Orchestrators can specify exact verification commands per acceptance criterion.
Specialists record command evidence into the task ledger before claiming a criterion.
Unverified specialist work is rejected and its worktree discarded.
